question: Which processed FEC Schedule A records corroborate, enrich, omit, or conflict with exact raw occurrences, and how does that evidence align to the currently effective raw filing revision?

inputs.role: Exact as-filed Schedule A occurrences, including source transaction references and physical provenance.
inputs.version_policy: Require the accepted 45-field raw layout and preserve extra physical fields separately.

inputs.role: Revision-aware effective raw Schedule A rows and the change from the prior effective filing.
inputs.version_policy: Require the exact calculation version and a projected, conserved row set.

inputs.role: Explicit field equivalence, applicability, and comparison rules between raw and processed representations.
inputs.version_policy: Pin field-map.json by SHA-256; a mapping or comparator change creates a new result.

inputs.role: Pinned complete processed Schedule A relation partition used for publishable reconciliation.
inputs.version_policy: Required for complete_snapshot. Pin the dump, relation layout, and exact extracted partition.

inputs.role: Targeted, time-bounded processed observations used for diagnostics and lag investigation.
inputs.version_policy: May produce only provisional_targeted_observation unless a separate contract proves complete partition coverage.

identity.result_key: processed evidence ID + raw report family ID + calculation version
identity.input_manifest: Ordered input contract versions, exact source digests, processed coverage state, field-map digest, and effective-projection digest.
identity.result_digest: SHA-256 of stable JSON over the complete reconciliation result.

ordered_steps: Verify every input digest, schema, coverage assertion, and source occurrence locator before matching.
Build direct-source candidate groups only from exact committee ID, filing number, and transaction ID. Do not use names, fuzzy text, or amount proximity to create identity.
Retain one-to-zero, one-to-one, one-to-many, and many-to-one groups explicitly. Resolve only a unique exact identity group; otherwise emit an unresolved group.

Compare the 43 mapped raw fields under field-map.json, retain two unmapped raw fields, and distinguish exact equality, absence, representation, processed enrichment, processed omission, material difference, and non-applicability.
Classify direct raw-to-processed evidence without confusing publisher enrichment or representation changes with source conflict.
Compare the processed filing revision with the selected effective raw revision before interpreting row differences.
Align direct evidence to each effective row: same filing, identical prior-filing content, different prior-filing content, or no support.
Conserve every raw occurrence, processed occurrence, and effective row; emit processed-only and unresolved groups rather than dropping them.
Emit the smallest committee and two-year-period change set implied by pending or conflicting effective rows.

decision_states.meaning: Exact identity is unique and all applicable source content agrees after explicit representation rules; processed-only enrichments remain labeled.
The identity is unique and differences are accepted representation changes only.
The effective raw content is newer than the available processed evidence or has no processed occurrence yet.
Aligned processed content differs materially from the same raw filing revision and requires investigation.
Strong identity or mapped source content conflicts and cannot be resolved by a declared comparator.
The candidate group is missing, ambiguous, incomplete, or cannot satisfy identity and conservation rules.

invariants: Raw source text, processed source values, physical locators, and response locators remain unchanged; comparison values are derived metadata.
Committee ID, filing number, and transaction ID are all required for direct-source identity. Form/line, back reference, date, and amount corroborate identity but cannot replace it.
A processed amendment action code does not determine the raw filing cover disposition.
Mutable nested committee and contributor master expansions cannot participate in Schedule A identity or source-content comparison.
Revision alignment is independent of field comparison. Older processed evidence cannot turn a newer raw modification into processed_changed.
A targeted API observation is diagnostic only and cannot feed user totals or prove a complete processed partition.
The seven comparable state counts sum to comparable_field_count for every direct match; unmapped is conserved separately.
Every input raw occurrence, processed occurrence, and effective row appears exactly once in a matched, pending, processed-only, conflict, or unresolved output state.
Receipt, report, election, filing, load, API-observation, and calculation times remain separate dimensions.

output.grain: One reconciliation result per processed evidence boundary and raw report family, containing direct occurrence matches plus one alignment state per current effective Schedule A row.

publication_states.meaning: A pinned complete processed partition and complete raw inputs satisfy identity, coverage, revision, and conservation gates.
Exact targeted evidence is useful for diagnostics but cannot support totals or complete absence claims.
A required source, partition, report family, or occurrence is incomplete.
At least one strong identity group is ambiguous or contradictory.
Input and output rows or field-state counts do not conserve.

revisions.input_change_policy: A new raw filing, processed snapshot, API observation, source correction, or coverage assertion creates a new immutable result and supersedes no evidence bytes.
revisions.method_change_policy: Any identity, mapping, comparator, revision-alignment, state, or publication change requires a new calculation version and regenerated fixtures.
revisions.history_policy: Retain every result with its input manifest so processing lag, publisher correction, and raw amendment history remain reconstructable.

checks.rule: All input and occurrence digests reproduce exactly and every referenced source object conforms to its pinned schema.
complete_snapshot requires a pinned complete processed two-year partition; targeted API observations remain provisional.
Every resolved direct match has exact committee ID, filing number, and transaction ID with one unique raw and processed occurrence.
Each direct comparison accounts for 43 comparable fields and two explicitly unmapped raw fields.
Direct raw plus processed-only plus unresolved outputs conserve all source occurrences, and effective outputs conserve the complete selected row set.
A processed_changed or conflict state requires evidence aligned to the same filing revision; older processed evidence yields pending state instead.
Processed values absent from raw remain named enrichments and cannot silently replace the source assertion.
Pending and conflict row keys reproduce the emitted affected committee and two-year-period keys exactly.

scenarios: 23 unique direct raw-to-processed matches with complete field-state conservation
processed publisher enrichment without source conflict
processed original filing lags a complete effective raw amendment
18 effective rows corroborated by identical prior-filing content
five modified and two added effective rows remain raw_only_pending_processing
targeted observation is diagnostic and ineligible for totals

propagation.no_change_policy: Identical input manifests and method versions reuse the prior result. New observations that do not change any direct or effective state create history but emit no downstream calculation change set.

use.retention: Retain complete reconciliation results, field maps, source evidence, coverage assertions, and issue history indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: Reconciliation proves an explicit relationship between pinned raw and processed evidence. It does not make targeted API coverage complete, erase filing revisions, or authorize aggregation of pending or conflicting rows.
